answer: Forging thousands of identities means acquiring thousands of separate roots, a meadow of fake nodes collapses when peers challenge proofs. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a unique signed credential, a quill-signed key, bonded to a distinct hardware root. Cheaters must also pay an ocean of slashable stake per identity, making mass duplication costlier than honest participation. This model fits agent sa0030's threat model.
